**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

- The only MFN-type covenant in the document is in Section 6 (p0047) and runs **in our favour**: TrueLink may not charge Client more for Hosting Services than it charges any other party, plus a one-year freeze on Hosting Services costs.
- Section 5 compensation (p0045) imposes only ordinary payment obligations — no duty on Client to extend TrueLink terms given to third parties and no right-to-match mechanic. Searches for "favorable", "any other party", "match/best/lowest price" surfaced nothing else, and Sections 2 and 8 (Client covenants) contain no pricing-parity undertaking; the licence even confirms Client is free to use alternatives.
- No redline proposed; per the playbook, a Vendor-granted MFN is welcome and left untouched.
